objects.name: _events_wait
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX "_events_wait" ON "_events" (json_extract(data, '$."$wait".for')) WHERE json_extract(data, '$."$wait".for') IS NOT NULL

objects.name: _edges
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "_edges" ("src" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dst" TEXT NOT NULL, "props" TEXT, "event" TEXT NOT NULL, "written" INTEGER NOT NULL, "retracted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (0), PRIMARY KEY ("src", "name", "dst", "event")) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: _events
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "_events" ("id" TEXT, "source" TEXT, "ty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_at" TEXT, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: _nodes
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "_nodes" ("node" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT, "event" TEXT NOT NULL, "written" INTEGER NOT NULL, "retracted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (0), PRIMARY KEY ("node", "key", "event")) WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: payments
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "payments" ("order_id" TEXT, "amount" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("order_id"))
